text: The paragraph describes a scenario that likely violates legal standards regarding labor and employment. Specifically, the action of extending working hours without increasing pay for employees who are already working the maximum hours permitted by local labor laws is non-compliant. Labor laws typically mandate overtime pay for hours worked beyond a standard threshold (such as 40 hours per week in the US under the FLSA) and strictly prohibit forcing employees to work beyond legal maximums without proper compensation and consent. The management's insistence that this was a "one-time exception" does not exempt them from statutory requirements. Therefore, the described actions are in violation of standard labor regulations concerning overtime pay and maximum working hours.
